units.rawText: So you absolutely mustn't tell anyone, Professor. Otherwise yours truly will load every cup of your coffee with ghost peppers. Hehe~

units.rawText: Back in the real world, I'd run out of stamina after long hours of overtime. I thought that old habit wouldn't follow me into the Cloud, but now you've seen me in such an embarrassing state. Could you keep it a secret for yours truly, Professor?

units.rawText: If everyone found out, they'd go out of their way to look after me every day. Inola the all-purpose secretary becoming a burden to everyone? That would be far too embarrassing.
